messages:
Ravi: Quick postmortem follow-up: root cause = ephemeral route-map flips + session cache SNI mismatch. Observed cross-region fallbacks when cached SNI didn't match the swapped backend cert, causing TLS_REJECT -> retry storm.
Tanya: Any numbers?
Ravi: ~3% of flows in the spike window, latency +400-900ms for affected requests.
Lin: Repro steps in short: run two edge nodes, flip route-map while client reuses session, set dns_ttl low and session_cache_ttl higher. Works reliably.
Ravi: Short-term mitigations proposed: 1) pause low-DNS-TTL experiments during rollouts; 2) add session SNI eviction on route updates; 3) add alert for tls_reject_retry_rate.
Tanya: Who owns what?
Ravi: I'll own the SNI eviction patch in net-runtime (ETA: 2026-04-06 EOD). Will include rollout plan: canary in eu-west-1, keep --sni-allowlist off on two backends for safety.
Lin: I'll add CI harness and a nightly regression test for DNS flip + session reuse (ETA: 2026-03-31).
Tanya: Ops runbook + experiment gating I will update (ETA: 2026-03-25).
ops-bot: scheduled: disable-low-ttl-experiments during route-rollouts (actioned).
deploy-bot: deploy/net-runtime/patch-2026-03-26 canary started in eu-west-1 :white_check_mark:
Ravi: I'll also add metrics: sni_evictions, cross_region_fallbacks, tls_reject_retry_rate. Josh (paging) suggested page on > 10/min for 1m.
Tanya: Please react with :white_check_mark: when tickets/PRs exist so I can link them to the PM.
Lin: :white_check_mark:
Ravi: :white_check_mark:
Tanya: Thanks all. I'll add these owners to the postmortem action tracker and schedule a 30m sync next week to confirm rollout telemetry. If you see similar patterns elsewhere, ping #incidents and @Ravi.
